metadata.question: Did the coastal city of La Serena experience at least 6cm of rainfall in July 2022?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about rainfall in La Serena, Chile in July 2022. I need to: 1. Use precipitation data - CHIRPS would be appropriate for rainfall 2. Define the location (La Serena, Chile - coastal city) 3. Filter for July 2022 (2022-07-01 to 2022-07-31) 4. Calculate total monthly rainfall and check if ≥ 6cm Let me break this down: - Data: CHIRPS daily precipitation (in mm) - Location: La Serena, Chile (approx coordinates: -29.9027, -71.2520) - Time: July 2022 - Conversion: 6cm = 60mm I'll need to: 1. Get CHIRPS collection for the time period 2. Sum daily precipitation to get monthly total 3. Check if collection is empty (C1) 4. Check if we have valid pixels after masking (C2) 5. Validate the result isn't null/NaN (C3) 6. Compare against 60mm threshold CHIRPS doesn't require cloud masking since it's precipitation data. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const laSerena = ee.Geometry.Point([-71.2520, -29.9027]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around La Serena const startDate = '2022-07-01'; const endDate = '2022-07-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - CHIRPS daily precipitation const chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(laSerena); const collectionSize = chirps.size().getInfo(); console.log(`July 2022 CHIRPS images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Calculate total monthly precipitation (mm) const monthlyPrecip = chirps.sum(); // 4. Check valid pixels const pixelCount = monthlyPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: laSerena, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid pixels in region: ${pixelCount}`); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 5. Calculate mean precipitation in region const meanPrecip = monthlyPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: laSerena, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('precipitation').getInfo(); console.log(`Total July 2022 rainfall: ${meanPrecip?.toFixed(2)} mm`); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (meanPrecip === null || meanPrecip === undefined || isNaN(meanPrecip)) { console.log("C3"); } else if (meanPrecip >= 60) { // 60mm = 6cm console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
